Senses.Explanation: The canon librarian is the monastic officer responsible for the scripture store and its collection. Liao’an Qingyu and Chushi Fanqi address identifiable holders of this office within working monasteries, while Gulin Qingmao’s documentary material places it among appointed posts. The title names a person responsible for the canon store, not the canon itself and not every monk who reads scripture.
